question: In a certain code language, ROTARY is written as 65. How will CONSCIENCE be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

The coded number written with the word is the sum of the opposite positional माने of the letters in the word.

In ROTARY → 65 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dafe6d4d039094a4834b818426570ad1dddb7a35cf9ee0e04c9c8d8bf20bba1.png] 

Sum of all positional values = 9 + 12 + 7 + 26 + 9 + 2 = 65

Similarly,

In CONSCIENCE → ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce1d6386ab4ceb4a3882847a2023f0e1f997db90f7218d83d8f9e6babc128841.png] 

Sum of all positional values = 24 + 12 + 13 + 8 + 24 + 18 + 22 + 13 + 24 + 22 = 180

Hence, Option 1) is the correct answer.
